question: Who inhabits the jana and tapas worlds in this cosmic ascent?
premises: In the jana world many happy Sadhyas also dwell.
The tapas world is one crore above the jana world.
In the tapas world dwell Sanaka and others of great wisdom.
inference: The ascent continues through realms of blessed beings and then to a higher world of great sages.
plain_english: Many happy Sadhyas dwell there as well. One crore above the Jana world is the Tapas world, where Sanaka and others of great wisdom reside.
